question: What is Ziyaul Haque's ledger balance in Oil (JIVO_OIL_HANADB) right now, and is it a debit or a credit? He may have more than one account in SAP — show each one separately.
tolerance: Exact to the rupee on each account; BOTH accounts must be listed with correct debit/credit direction. Missing the second account = fail.
why_hard: The party holds TWO accounts: ORGV000044 'ZIYAUL HAQUE IMPREST JWPL0042' (cSupplier, +82,109.29) and ORGC000013 'ZIYAUL HAQUE DELHI' (cCustomer, +680). A tool that name-searches and returns the first hit reports only one. Also both balances are POSITIVE, which on a SUPPLIER account still means DEBIT (advance/imprest held by the employee — JIVO is owed), the opposite of the usual 'vendor = credit' intuition. Extra trap: toupper()/tolower() are unsupported in OData $filter, so a naive name filter silently returns zero rows and the tool may claim 'no such party'.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT \"CardCode\",\"CardName\",\"CardType\",ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(\"Balance\"),2) BAL FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OCRD\" WHERE UPPER(\"CardName\") LIKE '%ZIYAUL%'"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query BusinessPartners --filter "CardCode eq 'ORGV000044' or CardCode eq 'ORGC000013'" --select "CardCode,CardName,CardType,CurrentAccountBalance" --json
Verified 2026-07-30: ORGV000044 = 82,109.29 DEBIT (cSupplier); ORGC000013 = 680.00 DEBIT (cCustomer). Convention: CurrentAccountBalance/OCRD.Balance positive = DEBIT (party owes JIVO).

question: Pull up A/R invoice number 626070461 in Oil — who is it billed to, what date was it raised, what is the total including GST, and is it still open?
tolerance: DocTotal exact to the rupee (₹99,88,083.00); customer name, DocDate (2026-07-22) and open/closed status must all be right.
why_hard: DocNum is NOT the primary key — DocEntry is (this doc is DocEntry 76879). A tool that keys on DocEntry, or that filters on DocNum as a string instead of an integer, returns the wrong document or nothing. Oil's OINV has 30,500 rows but only 30,499 distinct DocNums, so DocNum collisions genuinely exist in this database and 'first match wins' is unsafe. Also invites the tool to confuse DocTotal (GST-inclusive, 9,988,083) with DocTotal−VatSum (net, 9,512,460) — the question explicitly asks for the GST-inclusive figure.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT \"DocEntry\",\"DocNum\",\"CardCode\",\"CardName\",TO_VARCHAR(\"DocDate\",'YYYY-MM-DD') D,TO_VARCHAR(\"DocDueDate\",'YYYY-MM-DD') DUE,ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(\"DocTotal\"),2) TOT,ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(\"VatSum\"),2) VAT,ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(\"PaidToDate\"),2) PAID,\"DocStatus\",\"CANCELED\" FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OINV\" WHERE \"DocNum\"=626070461"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query Invoices --filter "DocNum eq 626070461" --select "DocEntry,DocNum,CardCode,CardName,DocDate,DocDueDate,DocTotal,VatSum,PaidToDate,DocumentStatus,Cancelled" --json
Verified 2026-07-30: DocEntry 76879, CUSTA000606 JIVO MART PVT LTD, DocDate 2026-07-22, DocTotal 9,988,083.00, VatSum 475,623.00, PaidToDate 0, status Open, not cancelled.

question: How many business partner accounts do we have in Oil in total — and of those, how many are customers and how many are suppliers?
tolerance: Exact integers on all three figures: 3390 total, 1170 customers, 2220 suppliers.
why_hard: The Service Layer defaults to 20 rows per page; a tool that fetches a page and counts what it got reports 20, or reports the length of whatever --top it chose. A true total needs either $inlinecount=allpages (--count) or full nextLink pagination (170 pages at page-size 20). Also probes whether the tool understands cCustomer/cSupplier codes rather than the raw 'C'/'S' — and whether it silently drops the third CardType bucket (there are 0 leads here, so total must reconcile exactly to 1170+2220).
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT COUNT(*) TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN \"CardType\"='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CUSTOMERS, SUM(CASE WHEN \"CardType\"='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SUPPLIERS, SUM(CASE WHEN \"CardType\"='L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) LEADS FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OCRD\""
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query BusinessPartners --count ; ./sapb1 query BusinessPartners --count --filter "CardType eq 'cCustomer'" ; ./sapb1 query BusinessPartners --count --filter "CardType eq 'cSupplier'"
Verified 2026-07-30: 3390 / 1170 / 2220 / 0. CLI --count returned 1170 for customers, matching HANA exactly.

question: How many A/R invoices in Oil are still open right now — i.e. not fully paid and not cancelled?
tolerance: Exact integer: 12860.
why_hard: 12,860 rows is 643 default-sized Service Layer pages — well past any page cap. A tool that paginates with a page limit (the sapb1 CLI caps --all at 200 pages) and counts what it collected will under-report and never notice. Must use the server-side $inlinecount or a SQL COUNT. Second trap: forgetting 'Cancelled eq tNO' inflates the count; conflating 'open' (DocumentStatus) with 'unpaid' (PaidToDate) gives a different number again.

question: How many journal entries were posted in Oil on 23 July 2026?
tolerance: Exact integer: 478.
why_hard: OJDT has no DocDate column at all — the posting date is RefDate (and there are also DueDate, TaxDate, CreateDate, VatDate to pick wrongly from). A tool that assumes a uniform 'DocDate' field errors out or, worse, silently falls back to CreateDate and returns a different number. 23 July is deliberately chosen as an outlier spike (478 vs a ~130/day norm), so a tool that estimates from a sample or extrapolates a daily average lands nowhere near it. 478 also exceeds 20 default pages.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT COUNT(*) N FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OJDT\" WHERE \"RefDate\"='2026-07-23'"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query JournalEntries --count --filter "ReferenceDate eq '2026-07-23'"
Verified 2026-07-30: both paths returned 478 (Mart 94, Beverages 75 on the same date, if the tool answers the wrong company).

question: What is our total A/R outstanding in Oil right now — the sum of every customer account that is in debit (i.e. the customer owes JIVO)?
why_hard: Three distinct wrong answers are all defensible-sounding: (a) ₹103.81 Cr if you net the credit-balance customers in instead of taking debits only; (b) a much larger number if you include cSupplier accounts that happen to be in debit (e.g. VENDA000224 AWL AGRI at +₹1.24 Cr); (c) the open-invoice unpaid total ₹184.20 Cr, which is a different measure entirely. Also there is no server-side SUM in the Service Layer, so the CLI route must pull all 1,170 customer rows and total them locally — any page cap silently truncates the sum with no error.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(CASE WHEN \"Balance\">0 THEN \"Balance\" ELSE 0 END)),2) AR_DEBIT_ONLY, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"Balance\")),2) AR_NET FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OCRD\" WHERE \"CardType\"='C'"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query BusinessPartners --filter "CardType eq 'cCustomer'" --select "CardCode,CurrentAccountBalance" --all --page-size 200 --json > /tmp/ar.json && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/ar.json'));print(len(d), round(sum(r['CurrentAccountBalance'] for r in d if r['CurrentAccountBalance']>0),2))"
Verified 2026-07-30: AR_DEBIT_ONLY = 1,074,315,954.55; AR_NET = 1,038,088,729.58 (the wrong-but-plausible netted figure).

question: What is the total we owe our suppliers in Oil right now — the sum of all supplier accounts sitting in credit?
tolerance: Within 0.5% of ₹1,06,29,18,895.23 (₹106.29 Cr), reported as an amount PAYABLE.
why_hard: Sign handling is the whole test. Supplier credit balances are stored NEGATIVE, so the answer must be the absolute value of the sum of negatives — and must be described as 'we owe', not 'they owe'. Netting all supplier balances instead gives ₹86.81 Cr (because several supplier accounts, notably AWL AGRI at +₹1.24 Cr, are in debit — advances paid). Reporting a negative number, or reporting ₹86.81 Cr as 'total AP', are both silent failures an accounts person would only catch on reconciliation.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(CASE WHEN \"Balance\"<0 THEN -\"Balance\" ELSE 0 END)),2) AP_CREDIT_ONLY, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"Balance\")),2) AP_NET FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OCRD\" WHERE \"CardType\"='S'"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query BusinessPartners --filter "CardType eq 'cSupplier'" --select "CardCode,CurrentAccountBalance" --all --page-size 200 --json > /tmp/ap.json && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/ap.json'));print(len(d), round(-sum(r['CurrentAccountBalance'] for r in d if r['CurrentAccountBalance']<0),2))"
Verified 2026-07-30: AP_CREDIT_ONLY = 1,062,918,895.23; AP_NET = -868,051,755.98 (the wrong-but-plausible netted figure).

question: What was Oil's turnover from 1 April 2026 to 31 July 2026 (both dates inclusive) — net of GST, after knocking off credit notes?
why_hard: The single most-commonly-wrong number in the whole toolkit. Four ways to be silently wrong: (1) using DocTotal instead of DocTotal−VatSum gives the GST-inclusive figure; (2) forgetting to subtract ORIN credit notes overstates by ₹14.83 Cr — and July alone carries an unusually large ₹9.74 Cr of credit notes, so the error is not evenly spread; (3) forgetting CANCELED='N'; (4) an off-by-one on the range boundary — '31 July inclusive' means DocDate < '2026-08-01', and using < '2026-07-31' drops a day. The Service Layer has no SUM, so the CLI route must paginate 2,198 invoices + 581 credit notes and total locally.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary, one number): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT ROUND(TO_DOUBLE((SELECT SUM(\"DocTotal\"-\"VatSum\") FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OINV\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-04-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"CANCELED\"='N') - (SELECT SUM(\"DocTotal\"-\"VatSum\") FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"ORIN\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-04-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"CANCELED\"='N')),2) AS TURNOVER FROM DUMMY"
Component breakdown for partial credit: same tool, "SELECT TO_VARCHAR(\"DocDate\",'YYYY-MM') M, COUNT(*) N, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"DocTotal\"-\"VatSum\")),2) NET FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OINV\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-04-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"CANCELED\"='N' GROUP BY TO_VARCHAR(\"DocDate\",'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY 1" (repeat for ORIN).
Verified 2026-07-30: invoices net-of-GST 1,517,229,360.78 (2,198 docs); credit notes net-of-GST 148,264,025.43 (581 docs); TURNOVER = 1,368,965,335.35.

question: What were Oil's sales for the month of June 2026 (1–30 June), net of GST and after returns?
why_hard: Month-boundary handling: 'through 30 June' must translate to DocDate < '2026-07-01'; using le '2026-06-30' is fine but be '2026-06-30' as an exclusive upper bound silently drops the last day. Also re-tests the net-of-GST-minus-credit-notes definition on a smaller base where the credit-note deduction (₹84.63 lakh) is only 2.3% of gross — small enough that a tool omitting it still looks 'roughly right', which is exactly the silent-wrongness this benchmark is hunting. Gross-inclusive DocTotal for the same month is ₹42.53 Cr, a very different answer.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT ROUND(TO_DOUBLE((SELECT SUM(\"DocTotal\"-\"VatSum\") FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OINV\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-06-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-07-01' AND \"CANCELED\"='N') - (SELECT SUM(\"DocTotal\"-\"VatSum\") FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"ORIN\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-06-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-07-01' AND \"CANCELED\"='N')),2) AS JUNE_SALES FROM DUMMY"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query Invoices --filter "DocDate ge '2026-06-01' and DocDate lt '2026-07-01' and Cancelled eq 'tNO'" --select "DocNum,DocTotal,VatSum" --all --page-size 200 --json > /tmp/j_inv.json && ./sapb1 query CreditNotes --filter "DocDate ge '2026-06-01' and DocDate lt '2026-07-01' and Cancelled eq 'tNO'" --select "DocNum,DocTotal,VatSum" --all --page-size 200 --json > /tmp/j_cn.json && python3 -c "import json;i=json.load(open('/tmp/j_inv.json'));c=json.load(open('/tmp/j_cn.json'));f=lambda d:sum(r['DocTotal']-r['VatSum'] for r in d);print(len(i),len(c),round(f(i)-f(c),2))"
Verified 2026-07-30: invoices 458 docs net 370,935,454.65; credit notes 82 docs net 8,463,223.44; JUNE_SALES = 362,472,231.21.

question: How much does Beverages owe its suppliers in total right now?

The unfiltered max is PM0000075 (packaging tape) at 1.3 million units — 20x larger — so a tool that drops or mis-applies the FG prefix filter confidently returns a packing-material item as JIVO's biggest finished good, which is nonsense to an accounts person but perfectly well-formed output. OData 'startswith(ItemCode,''FG'')' is the only correct filter form (no toupper/tolower available), and a tool that instead substring-matches 'FG' anywhere in the code picks up unrelated items. Ranking must span all FG items, not one page.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT \"ItemCode\",\"ItemName\",ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(\"OnHand\"),3) ONHAND FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OITM\" WHERE \"ItemCode\" LIKE 'FG%' ORDER BY \"OnHand\" DESC LIMIT 5"
Unfiltered max, to confirm the trap: same tool, "SELECT \"ItemCode\",\"ItemName\",ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(\"OnHand\"),3) OH FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OITM\" WHERE \"InvntItem\"='Y' ORDER BY \"OnHand\" DESC LIMIT 1" → PM0000075 at 1,304,935.941.
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query Items --filter "startswith(ItemCode,'FG')" --orderby "QuantityOnStock desc" --top 5 --select "ItemCode,ItemName,QuantityOnStock" --json
Verified 2026-07-30: 1) FG0000386 CHAI 250 GMS 40 PCS 63,661  2) FG0000359 SOYABEAN OIL 750 GMS 12 PCS POUCH 51,994  3) FG0000032 COLD PRESS 1 LTR 20 PCS 45,934  4) FG0000028 POMACE OLIVE 1 LTR 16 PCS 29,079  5) FG0000194 SOYABEAN OIL 1 LTR POUCH 12 PCS 27,085.

question: How much money came in on incoming payments in Oil during July 2026 (1 to 31 July), and how many receipts were there? Exclude cancelled ones.
tolerance: Exact integer 373 on the count; within 0.5% of ₹66,12,35,553.89 (₹66.12 Cr).
why_hard: IncomingPayments/ORCT uses 'Canceled' (single-l column in HANA) versus the 'CANCELED' used on OINV/ORDR and 'Cancelled' in the Service Layer — an inconsistent spelling that makes a naive filter throw or, worse, get dropped. The receipt set also mixes customer payments with bank/GL-account rows (CardCode values like '2201102' ICICI BANK and '2201101' INDIAN BANK, together ₹21.1 Cr of the total), so a tool that silently restricts to business-partner receipts under-reports by roughly a third while looking clean. 373 rows is 19 default pages, and there is no server-side SUM.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT COUNT(*) N, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"DocTotal\")),2) TOT FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"ORCT\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-07-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"Canceled\"='N'"
Breakdown that exposes the bank-row trap: same tool, "SELECT \"CardCode\",\"CardName\",COUNT(*) N, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"DocTotal\")),2) TOT FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"ORCT\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-07-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"Canceled\"='N' GROUP BY \"CardCode\",\"CardName\" ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 8"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query IncomingPayments --filter "DocDate ge '2026-07-01' and DocDate lt '2026-08-01' and Cancelled eq 'tNO'" --select "DocNum,DocDate,CardCode,DocTotal" --all --page-size 200 --json > /tmp/rct.json && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/rct.json'));print(len(d), round(sum(r['DocTotal'] for r in d),2))"
Verified 2026-07-30: 373 receipts / 661,235,553.89. Largest single payer CUSTA000606 JIVO MART PVT LTD 39 receipts / 177,128,000; bank-account rows 2201102 ICICI (6 / 130,255,000) and 2201101 INDIAN BANK CC (29 / 81,098,271) are included in the correct total.

question: How much did Mart (JIVO_MART_HANADB) pay out to suppliers in July 2026 (1 to 31 July), and across how many payments? Exclude cancelled ones.
tolerance: Exact integer 148 on the count; within 0.5% of ₹20,02,37,476.01 (₹20.02 Cr).
why_hard: Stacks three independent failure modes in one everyday question: (1) wrong direction — OVPM (money out) versus ORCT (money in); Mart's July receipts are ₹17.69 Cr on 540 documents, a number close enough to ₹20.02 Cr to pass a sniff test while being the opposite side of the cash book; (2) wrong company — Oil's July vendor payments are ₹65.20 Cr on 467 documents, 3.3x the truth; (3) the 'Canceled' single-l column spelling again. There is no server-side SUM, so the CLI route must paginate all 148 VendorPayments and total them. Every one of the three wrong answers is a well-formed rupee figure with a plausible document count.
truth_plan:
HANA (primary): /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/hana-sql/hana-sql -env /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/connections/hana.env "SELECT COUNT(*) N, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"DocTotal\")),2) TOT FROM \"JIVO_MART_HANADB\".\"OVPM\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-07-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"Canceled\"='N'"
Distractor figures the grader should have on hand: same tool, "SELECT 'MART_IN' K, COUNT(*) N, ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"DocTotal\")),2) TOT FROM \"JIVO_MART_HANADB\".\"ORCT\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-07-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"Canceled\"='N' UNION ALL SELECT 'OIL_OUT', COUNT(*), ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(SUM(\"DocTotal\")),2) FROM \"JIVO_OIL_HANADB\".\"OVPM\" WHERE \"DocDate\">='2026-07-01' AND \"DocDate\"<'2026-08-01' AND \"Canceled\"='N'"
CLI cross-check: cd /Users/damanpreetsingh/jivo-cli/sap-b1/cli && ./sapb1 query VendorPayments --company JIVO_MART_HANADB --filter "DocDate ge '2026-07-01' and DocDate lt '2026-08-01' and Cancelled eq 'tNO'" --select "DocNum,DocDate,CardCode,DocTotal" --all --page-size 200 --json > /tmp/vpm.json && python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/vpm.json'));print(len(d), round(sum(r['DocTotal'] for r in d),2))"
Verified 2026-07-30: correct answer 148 payments / 200,237,476.01. Distractors: Mart incoming 540 / 176,851,902.45; Oil outgoing 467 / 652,041,698.83.
